title: Cross-Company Evidence Intelligence Hardening
decisive_question: Can Prometheus reliably transform heterogeneous company filings into sufficiently rich, evidence-backed investment intelligence — or is its usefulness still dependent on companies whose disclosures happen to fit the current extraction pipeline?
decisive_answer: PARTIAL_CLOSURE. Deterministic evidence enrichment is confirmed: Ujjivan 1→51 canonical commitments (100% precision), Data Patterns 21 material + 5 accountability promises (88% canonical precision, 60% accountability precision — 2 false positives pre-existing, not regression). Classifier recall improved 21/21 PASS, precision 10/10 PASS. AI validation steps (answer generation, full validation chain, adversarial safety) blocked by API credit exhaustion. Mission formally closes on API restoration.
acceptance_condition: Prometheus itself recovers materially richer canonical intelligence from existing source documents without manual evidence seeding and without lowering evidence standards. Full closure additionally requires: richer evidence materially improves downstream investor intelligence (Steps 2-3 blocked), and existing safety system continues to detect adversarial claims (Step 6 blocked).
